sections.text:
This procedure
 details the steps required to check the value of dew point of the Sulphur Hexa
 fluoride (SF6) gas. It is important that
 test is performed on the gas so that any change in its properties can be
 noticed by measuring the moisture value in it.

The most accurate
 test results will always be obtained at close to atmospheric pressure, when
 testing (SF6) gas under system pressure you have to use a pressure reducing
 valve and adjust it at the sampling point to approximately 1 bar above
 atmospheric pressure to obtain actual and accurate results.

sections.text:
Note: 
 New SF6 gas should
 have a moisture content less than 125ppmv equivalent to 15 ppmg.

Used gas should
 have a moisture content less than 500ppmv (62ppmg), and if it is more, the
 gas should be exchanged with new gas or in the case of GIS equipment (a very
 large quantity of gas) it is more economical to use the gas truck to
 re-condition the gas.

Introduction
This procedure
 details the steps required to check the value of dew point of the Sulphur Hexa

The most accurate

 atmospheric pressure to obtain actual and accurate results.
